scope: Prospective bounded spelling policy for candidate1800v1; no paid registration or final qualification.
primary_matching: Same one-answer extractor and NFC normalization; exact per-item canonical plus prospectively reviewed finite whitelist.
mandatory_gate: Independently adjudicate every usable unrecognized answer before it contributes to a linguistic-error or advancement claim. Retain unresolved cases and the full denominator. Apply demonstrated corrections symmetrically across all affected questions/models, including recognized answers where implicated.
completion_policy: Report all-request and usable denominators, refusals, truncations, errors and unparsed outputs separately. No difficulty claim based only on unusable answers.
execution_requirement: Pin adoption, source policy, candidate and input review, scorer, alias rules, extractor, full cohort and paired analysis before paid submission.
